\section*{Problem A: Apples}
Alice has $N$ apples arranged in a row. Each apple $i$ has weight $w_i$. She wants to split the row
into two non-empty parts with equal total weight.

\subsection*{Input}
The input consists of a single line with $N$ ($2 \le N \le 10^6$) followed by $N$ integers.

\subsection*{Output}
Output \texttt{YES} if it is possible, and \texttt{NO} otherwise.

\begin{tabular}{|p{6cm}|p{6cm}|}
\hline
Sample Input 1 & Sample Output 1 \\
\hline
\texttt{4 1 2 3 0} & \texttt{YES} \\
\hline
\texttt{3 1 1 1} & \texttt{NO} \\
\hline
\end{tabular}
\newpage
\section*{Problem B: Bridges}
Bob wants to cross $M$ bridges. Each bridge connects two islands.
